parts.text: Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, and inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. Before and during a flight, things happen outside our control, such as the load being ready or not, the drone reaching the points of its job, and the drone arriving. Radio coverage is patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, and reports from drones come through relay stations that can arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Drones sometimes restart in flight after a software fault and carry on, and batteries drain faster in cold and wind than planned.
